A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete 49-page versions of the same work. Their text, equations, figures, tables, Appendices A–E, and checklist support reliable comparison throughout.

before.justification: v3 reports original synthetic and PopQA-OCR LLM experiments in Tables 1–2, plus one-layer attention experiments in Section 3.2 and Appendix C.

after.justification: v4 retains the original synthetic and PopQA-OCR LLM results and the one-layer attention experiments, including the appendix results.

M1.justification: Equations 1–5 retain the same factorized and non-factorized attention models, prediction rules, and cross-entropy objectives. The added theorem condition does not change the architecture or training procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same five synthetic LLM association scenarios, symbolic OCR task, and PopQA-OCR place-of-birth/sport question-answering scenario (Sections 2–3 and Appendix D).

E2.justification: Tables 1–2 retain Gemma-2-9B, OLMo-7B, Qwen-2-7B, Mistral-7B-v0.3, and Llama-3-8B. The one-layer comparisons remain factorized versus non-factorized. Newly cited Zhang et al. (2025) is not an evaluated comparator.

E3.justification: The synthetic LLM and PopQA-OCR training-subject ratios remain 0.2 and 0.5, respectively. Metrics, sample sizes, training budgets, learning-rate selection, and one-layer configurations are unchanged. The new rank condition is theoretical.

E4.justification: Appendix C retains the same loss curves, full-weight inspections, numerical SVM analysis, and intrinsic-dimension sweep in Figures 3–6. Appendix E's training-trajectory analysis in Figure 7 is also unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions report standard errors from three random-seed runs in Tables 1–2 and three-seed averages with standard-deviation shading in Figure 7. Run-count disclosures and uncertainty-reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: Tables 1–2 and Figures 2–7 preserve their values, curves, and findings. For example, Table 2's Gemma-2-9B PopQA-OCR mean rank remains 0.68 (0.27). No empirical result entries are added or removed.

T1.justification: Theorem 1 and Lemma 1 newly assume d_h >= r, where r is the rank of an optimal nuclear-norm SVM solution W*. Appendix A.2 changes W* from a merely feasible to an optimal solution and adds zero-padded SVD factors for d_h > r. This locally corrects dimensional feasibility in the equivalence argument; the remaining theoretical results are retained.

C1.justification: The abstract, introductory contributions, and conclusion retain the shared-OCR explanation for generalization and hallucination and the factorization/implicit-bias account. No main contribution is added, removed, or redefined.

C2.justification: v4 explicitly qualifies the SVM-equivalence result by requiring sufficient factor width to represent an optimal nuclear-norm solution, adding an applicability boundary absent from v3's theorem and lemma statements. Interpretations of hallucination, sample efficiency, and other stated limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Appendix E retains the same optimizer, hyperparameters, training durations, dataset-generation information, hardware, runtime disclosure, and code-access link. No implementation or reproducibility information is added or revised.

R1.justification: Section 1.1 and the references add Zhang et al. (2025), Training dynamics of in-context learning in linear attention. The added passage discusses parameterization-dependent ICL dynamics alongside the paper's generalization focus; broader positioning remains intact.

P1.justification: v4 makes localized additions to related-work prose, theorem preambles, and the Appendix A.2 explanation, and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. Section order, terminology, and the overall narrative remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–7 and Tables 1–3 retain their content and design. Additions cause limited page reflow: Section 3.2 now starts below Figure 2, Theorem 2's equation boxes move to page 9, and the conclusion moves to page 10.

improvement.justification: The explicit rank condition in Theorem 1/Lemma 1 and the zero-padding construction in Appendix A.2 address an unstated dimensional requirement in v3's SVM-equivalence argument. This improves theoretical precision and proof completeness, while the new citation modestly improves context. The empirical evidence and principal conclusions remain unchanged.
